verdict.rationale: Controlling whether conversations are used for model training is a fair trust-controls question for a cloud AI agent like Perplexity Computer, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions a training opt-out, data-retention setting, or privacy toggle. The pack covers MCP integration, the sandboxed VM, analytics and OAuth, none of which address training-data controls. Community comments about privacy-focused hardware are general and not about training controls.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models
